Nikita Chauhan | nikita.chauhan305@example.com | +91 9813506329
Pune
Notice period: 60 days

Professional Summary
Senior QA Automation Engineer with a strong background in designing and executing automated test frameworks, API testing, and CI/CD integration. Experienced in improving test coverage, reducing release defects, and enabling faster delivery cycles through automation and tooling.

Technical Skills
Selenium, Test Automation, Java, Postman, Jenkins, JUnit, Jira, Git, Confluence

Work Experience

Senior QA Automation Engineer, Freshworks (Apr 2020 - Present)
- Developed and maintained a Selenium-based regression suite integrated with Jenkins pipelines to validate key customer workflows, reducing manual regression time by 60% while improving release quality; used Git for source control and Confluence for test documentation.
- Implemented Postman collections and automated API checks as part of pre-release validation, catching critical API contract regressions and enabling automated smoke verification for nightly builds.
- Built JUnit-based test harnesses for component-level verification and integrated results into Jira for traceability and defect triage with development teams.

Test Engineer, Zoho (Aug 2012 - Mar 2020)
- Designed Test Automation frameworks in Java using Selenium and JUnit to cover functional and UI scenarios across core product modules, increasing automated coverage for high-risk areas and decreasing escaped defects to production.
- Integrated test runs with Jenkins to enable nightly and pre-release pipelines; authored Git workflows and maintained test artifacts and runbooks in Confluence for cross-team collaboration.
- Led API and integration validation using Postman and automated checks, tracked issues and test plans in Jira to streamline defect lifecycle and release readiness.

Education
M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad
